about: Known preinstalled Android TV packages. Groups: ads/telemetry are offered together (one confirmation); app/feature are asked one by one, default keep; launcher is only touched by `tvctl.py home` after TV Home is verified. Packages are only ever disabled for user 0 (pm disable-user), never uninstalled. Sources: Universal Android Debloater list, community TV guides, and package behaviour; always confirm on the actual TV.

com.google.android.leanbacklauncher.reco.label: Android TV Home recommendations
com.google.android.leanbacklauncher.reco.what: Feeds sponsored and suggested rows to the old Android TV home screen.
com.google.android.leanbacklauncher.reco.breaks: Nothing you need once TV Home is your home screen.

com.google.android.tvrecommendations.label: Android TV Core Services (recommendations)
com.google.android.tvrecommendations.what: Supplies recommendation and 'sponsored' rows to the stock home screen.
com.google.android.tvrecommendations.breaks: Recommendation rows on the stock home screen. Rated 'expert' by UAD because it does more on some TVs: disable, then check Live TV and inputs still work.

com.google.android.feedback.label: Google Feedback

com.google.android.youtube.tv.label: YouTube
com.google.android.youtube.tv.breaks: YouTube and the YouTube button on the remote.

com.google.android.videos.label: Google TV / Play Movies
com.google.android.videos.what: Google's film and TV store and watchlist app.

com.google.android.play.games.label: Google Play Games
com.google.android.play.games.breaks: Cloud saves and achievements in some games.

com.google.android.apps.tv.dreamx.label: Ambient mode
com.google.android.apps.tv.dreamx.what: Google TV's screensaver, which also shows suggestions.

com.netflix.ninja.label: Netflix
com.netflix.ninja.breaks: Netflix and the Netflix button on the remote.

com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom.label: Prime Video
com.amazon.amazonvideo.livingroom.breaks: Prime Video and its remote button.
